Facts: 1) Illegal occupation of basic farmland, changing land use, causing damage. This is "非法占用农用地罪" (illegal occupation of farmland) under Article 338 of Criminal Law (now Article 338? The description: "非法占用耕地，改变用途，数量较大，造成耕地大量毁坏" matches "非法占用农用地罪" (illegal occupation of farmland) and "破坏耕地罪". Under Chinese law, Article 338: "非法占用耕地" is punishable. Also Article 338 includes "破坏耕地" maybe separate. Actually Article 338: "非法占用耕地" and "破坏耕地" are separate? Let's recall: Article 338 (old) says: "非法占用耕地，情节严重的，处三年以下有期徒刑或者拘役，并处罚金；情节特别严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also "破坏耕地" is Article 338? Might be Article 338 for both. Anyway we can list "非法占用农用地罪" (or "非法占用耕地罪").

2) The assault: "结伙随意殴打他人，情节恶劣" => crime of "聚众斗殴罪" (gathering to fight) or "故意伤害罪"? They inflicted minor injuries. The act: group assault causing minor injuries. But we need only crimes directly supported by this part. Both are supported. So list both.

Thus final answer: [罪名]非法占用农用地罪;聚众斗殴罪;故意伤害罪<eoa>
